encode_video_with_cogvideox_vae: encode a video tensor into latent representations using AutoencoderKLCogVideoX encode method
decode_latents_with_cogvideox_vae: decode latent vectors back into video frames using AutoencoderKLCogVideoX decode method
enable_tiled_vae_decoding: enable tiled VAE decoding on AutoencoderKLCogVideoX to reduce memory usage for large videos
build_causal_conv3d_layer: build a CogVideoXCausalConv3d layer with specified in_channels, out_channels, and kernel_size for video models
review_safe_conv3d_oom_handling: review the CogVideoXSafeConv3d forward method that chunks large tensors to avoid out of memory errors
